name: prounivers-mafia-bot-ultimate
description: Production-ready Telegram Mafia Bot with owner/admin control, economy, clans, quests, achievements, clone marketplace, clone-owner/admin control, scoped clone settings and 24/7 health service.

scripts.check-all: node -e "const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process"),p=require("path");let bad=0;function w(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const x=p.join(d,f),s=fs.statSync(x);if(s.isDirectory())w(x);else if(x.endsWith(".js")){try{cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,["--check",x],{stdio:"ignore"})}catch(e){console.error("SYNTAX:",x);bad++}}}}w(".");process.exit(bad?1:0)"
